title: SOCIAL BIAS FRAMES: Reasoning about Social and Power Implications of Language
reasoning: The paper introduces a dataset (SBIC) and a framework for evaluating social biases that specifically includes 'religion/culture' as one of the key targeted group categories. Additionally, it benchmarks the ability of models to detect 'offensiveness' and 'intent to offend', which involves evaluating moral and ethical dimensions of language beyond a simple ethics statement.
